concerns.text: FR-003 and Spec Edge Case 2 require the system to calculate patristic distances handling polytomies as 'average path length'. Task T017 implements this calculation but is marked incomplete [ ]. Without T017, the distance matrix required for the Mantel test (FR-005, SC-001) cannot be generated, leaving the core hypothesis untestable.

FR-005 and SC-001 mandate a Mantel test with 999 permutations and explicit null distribution analysis. Task T019 is marked incomplete [ ]. The task description mentions saving the null distribution and validation logs, but without the implementation, the statistical significance (p-value) cannot be determined, failing the primary success criterion.

Spec US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3 and SC-003/SC-005 require strict data loss validation (>20% threshold halts execution) and retention reporting. Tasks T020a (orchestration logic) and T020b (SC-003 verification) are marked incomplete [ ]. The pipeline lacks the logic to enforce the data loss constraint or report the retention metric.

Spec US-2 requires a Partial Mantel test (FR-006) and stratified analysis (Constitution Principle VII). Tasks T025b (stratified subset), T026 (Partial Mantel implementation), and T027 (result aggregation/warning logic) are all marked incomplete [ ]. The system cannot isolate environmental effects or satisfy the research question's core requirement.

Spec US-1 Independent Test requires validation of the full pipeline and a negative control (shuffled profiles). Tasks T011 (Integration test) and T012 (Negative control test) are marked incomplete [ ]. Without these tests, the 'Independent Test' acceptance criteria for US-1 cannot be verified.

Spec US-3 requires generation of specific figures (heatmap, scatter plot) and a text summary. Tasks T030, T031, and T032 are marked incomplete [ ]. The deliverables for US-3 (visualization and reporting) are missing implementation tasks.

Spec SC-004 requires runtime measurement against the CI time limit. Tasks T037 (runtime verification) and T037a (assertion logic) are marked incomplete [ ]. The system cannot verify compliance with the 6-hour performance goal.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and V (Versioning) require checksumming of raw data and updating the state YAML. Task T021 is marked incomplete [ ]. The pipeline cannot satisfy the mandatory data hygiene and versioning constraints.

Plan Technical Context and Spec FR-001/FR-003 require system binaries (mafft, fasttree) and environment validation. Tasks T002a (binary install), T003 (linting), and T008 (env validation) are marked incomplete [ ]. The foundational environment required to run the pipeline is not fully specified as complete.

Task T025b is tagged [US2] but the description focuses on 'stratified subset analysis' which the Spec US-2 explicitly states is 'methodologically insufficient' on its own. While the task exists, the description should clarify that this is a *supplementary* analysis to the Partial Mantel test (T026) to satisfy Constitution Principle VII, rather than a replacement, to avoid confusion about the primary method.
